notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
Small update here.

1. Fixed a serious bug in the line path puzzles when you pressed down on the movable block multiple time very quickly. Really weird stuff could happen...

2. Added the ability to replay the tutorial from the Menu in case you need a refresher on how to play the game. Press the menu and press the "Tutorial" button.

Cheers

Gabe

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

I've got another update for you guys here. Not a huge one but a couple new features.

#1.  Added a path line for puzzles in the black, white and gray levels. (Also fixed an exploit where you could cheat the puzzles in these levels). Now there is a simple green line that follows that path of the blocks you move so you can trace back over your path a little easier. If you have already beat these puzzles, this won't effect you at all.

#2.  I've improved the AI a little bit. I noticed it tended to value a certain type of play over another in situations where it wasn't that advantageous to do so. So I've fixed that. AI is a tricky thing though... Not really sure if the change will be very noticeable, or if it has other side effects. Will have to wait and see!

#3.  I've implemented the ability to use the right mouse button to deselect a card in the card game. Just a quick way to deselect if you want to use it.

That's it for this one! Please feel free to keep posting suggestions in the Discussions page. I check it regularly and have been getting good feedback so far :)

I am still struggling to get more reviews for the game - which helps get a little more exposure for Triplicity. Ao if you are enjoying the game and have a spare moment, I'd really appreciate it.

Cheers!

Gabe

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Just published update #1 with the following changes:

1. Changed how the cards you can select for Draft Tournaments work. Now each card of the three you can choose from is the same rarity. Also changed the percentages a bit.

2. Allowed for more than 30 cards to be added to a deck in the Card Library. You still cannot play a match with a deck that doesn't have exactly 30 cards, but this will allow players to add cards they know they want to add to a deck before removing the cards they want to remove.

3. If you win a tournament, you will receive a bonus golden rare or uncommon card as an extra reward.

4. Added 2 new Achievements: 
   - Flawless Victory (win a match without taking damage)
   - Collector (collect all cards in the game)

An indicator has been added in the Card Library to display how many different cards you have collected.

5. Fixed a bug where you could progress through the game without solving puzzles.

6. Fixed a bug where you could play cards in the card game without having enough energy if you timed your clicks in a very specific way.

That's all for this update.

Just wanted to take a second and say thank you for checking out the game :) As a lone developer, it is always really nice to see people appreciate the work that goes into a game :D The feedback I have gotten on the game so far has been great!  

Please feel free to leave a review if you haven't already, that will hopefully help get the game a little more attention!

Cheers,

Gabe
